nextStoryContext: The 'container-auth-unavailable' discriminator is now registered in all three required sites of src/supervisor/sidecar-stalled.ts (SidecarStalledReason type, VALID_REASONS array, JSDoc list on the type and on the file header block) plus round-trip coverage in test/supervisor/sidecar-stalled.test.ts. readSidecarStalledMarker/writeSidecarStalledMarker/removeSidecarStalledMarker themselves are reason-agnostic (they only validate against VALID_REASONS), so no other code path needed changes for this story. If a future story needs to WRITE this marker with reason='container-auth-unavailable' from the actual container-mode auth-preflight producer (not yet wired), that producer call site still needs to be located and wired up -- this story only unblocks the round-trip, it does not add a new producer call site.
